title_en: Dream of the Red Chamber (14/20): A Wedding to Ward Off Illness
note_en: The text uses 不如 to make a suggestion: 不如赶快把宝钗娶过来 "we might as well bring Baochai in as his bride right away." Literally 不如 means "is not as good as," so the speaker is implying "anything else would be worse than doing this." English uses "why not..." or "we'd better..." for the same idea.
